description: Lists the infrastructure as code providers, tools and modules whose releases are read for breaking changes, each with its newest tracked release. Use it to find the key that get_provider_changes takes.
name: list_providers

as_of.description: The UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) every value that depends on the day was counted for.

count.description: Number of entries in this answer.

generated_at.description: Moment this answer was built (ISO 8601, UTC).

name.description: Name of the license, or the words that say none is chosen yet.

note.description: What that means for reuse of the data.

url.description: Address of the license text, or null when there is none.

providers.description: The providers and tools, then the modules, in the order of the site.

breaking_releases.description: Number of tracked stable releases whose release notes were read and list at least one breaking change.

breaking_releases_last_12_months.description: Number of tracked stable releases published in the twelve months up to the as_of day whose release notes were read and list at least one breaking change.

counted_since.description: Set when the tracked releases start less than twelve months before the as_of day: the oldest tracked version, where that count really starts. Null otherwise.

key.description: Key of the entry: the provider key (for example azurerm) or the name of the module. It is the last part of its page address.

kind.description: What the entry is: a Terraform provider, a tool or language, or a module.

latest_confirmed.description: True when the tracked list holds every stable release from oldest_tracked_version on, so latest_version is the latest stable release. False when it is only the newest release tracked here: a newer one may exist.

latest_date.description: Day that release was published (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when it is not known.

latest_notes_read.description: False when the newest release is known from the Terraform Registry only and has no GitHub release: its release notes were not read. Null when no release is loaded.

latest_notes_url.description: The page latest_version and latest_date were read from: its release notes, or its page in the Terraform Registry. Null when no release is loaded.

latest_version.description: The newest tracked stable release, without a leading v. Null when none is loaded.

namespace.description: Where the entry is published: its address in the Terraform Registry, or its GitHub repository when it is not in the registry.

oldest_tracked_version.description: The oldest tracked stable release. Releases before it were not read. Null when none is loaded.

registry_url.description: Page of a module in the Terraform Registry. Null for providers and tools.

repo_url.description: The GitHub repository whose releases are read.

subject.description: What a module deploys, as the Azure Verified Modules index names it. Null for providers and tools.

url.description: Page of the entry on the site.

site.description: The site the data comes from.

title: List providers, tools and modules
